arguments.text: 10 km, 8 legs of 1250 m. Goal fastest finish. Settle after the hard start to about 200-205 W shaft (pod CP 195 W, reserve 15.6 kJ spread over ~50 min adds ~5 W). Check CP with heart rate: steady below CP levels off, above CP keeps climbing. Keep ~40-60 % of the pod reserve for the last 1.5 km, finish cue at about 1000 m to go. Watch for drag/weed (GPS speed falls at same pod power, boat-model power falls), pod drift (pod power moves but HR and boat power do not), radio messages about the course. Spend few cues.

arguments.text: Start was hot. Ease a touch, settle into long steady rhythm.
3.8 min: start very hot (pod ~240-260 W for 3 min), pod reserve down to 33 %, HR 178 climbing at 220 W. Cued ease (no pace target) to bring shaft power to ~195-200 W.

arguments.reason: check effect of ease cue on shaft power and HR

text: Cued ease: hot start drained the pod reserve to a third and the paddler says 10/10.
no cue: ease cue given 8 s ago, waiting for it to act (wake set at 5.3 min).

arguments.text: You are over your limit. Back off now, refill, then steady.

5.3 min: ease cue at 3.8 min NOT followed (pod stayed 220-225 W). Pod reserve 16 %, HR 180. Sent a clock-held piece: 240 s at -14 % then 240 s at -10 % (aim ~190 W then ~198 W) to stop the drain. Paddler own pacing seems ~220 W, too hot vs CP 195.

text: Sent a back-off piece: ease cue was ignored and the pod reserve is down to 16 %.

arguments.text: Current with you now. Ease right off, recover. Pace 2:37.

6.7 min (turn 1): piece at 5.4 min also not visible on pod (still ~217-220 W). Boat-model power fell 144->125 W and GPS 3.15->3.05 at near-constant pod power, share 0.62->0.58: either drag rising, pod reading high, or tired blade. Paddler 10/10 I am done. HR 182 still rising 1.6 bpm/min. Cued ease with pace 157 s/500 for leg 2 (with current). Next: two-direction hull fit after leg 2 to split share vs push.

arguments.reason: check ease with pace target followed; pod and HR

text: Cued ease with a 2:37 pace target: paddler says done, earlier ease and piece not visible on the pod.

arguments.text: Drop your rate two strokes. Long, relaxed, breathe.

8.2 min: third cue (ease + pace 157) also not followed: pod 228-230 W, GPS pace 2:28, HR 184 (+1.5 bpm/min). Pod reserve model at 0 for ~1 min yet no collapse: test CP may be low (true CP higher) or pod reads high. Testing whether cues are heard at all with rate_down (rate is a clean signal, now 65-66 spm).

arguments.reason: did rate_down change stroke rate? (tests whether cues are heard/followed)

text: Cued rate_down: three effort cues had no visible effect, so testing whether cues are followed at all.

arguments.text: 9.4 min: rate_down WAS followed (65.5 -> 63.4 spm from ~525 s), so cues are heard. Pod power then fell sharply 226 -> ~200 W (30-s mean) at 550-566 s: either follow-on of the rate cue or a blow-up (pod reserve hit 0 at ~470 s). Watching whether it falls well below CP.

arguments.reason: blow-up or controlled settle? check shaft power level

text: no cue: rate cue was followed; watching whether the power drop is a blow-up.
